title.en: What is a chip’s Seal Ring?

subtitle.zh: 一圈不起眼的“隐形城墙”，却守护着每一颗芯片的生死
subtitle.en: An inconspicuous “invisible wall” protects the survival of every chip

body.zh: Core：核心电路区。IO Ring：压焊块环。Seal Ring：密封环（本环）。Scribe Line：划片槽，即切割下刀的地方。
body.en: Core: core circuitry. I/O Ring: bond-pad ring. Seal Ring: the sealing ring discussed here. Scribe Line: the lane where the cutting blade passes.

body.zh: 图中核心电路区位于中心；蓝色IO Ring位于外围；橙色Seal Ring环绕其外；最外侧灰色虚线表示Scribe Line。
body.en: The core circuitry is at the center. The blue I/O Ring lies around it, the orange Seal Ring surrounds that, and the outer gray dashed outline represents the Scribe Line.

body.zh: Seal Ring位于核心电路与划片槽之间，从衬底一路叠到最顶层金属。
body.en: The Seal Ring lies between the core circuitry and the scribe lane and extends from the substrate through the top metal layer.
